PhysicalMetricsNote: No process-local managed allocation heap/stack/GC model exists. Global CLR GC values are not substituted for process metrics.
ReductionModelNote: Cumulative counter records actual cooperative runtime charges; exact native numeric counts depend on execution implementation and are not claimed.
PriorityModelNote: Current normal scheduler state only; priority flags/options and relative scheduling remain unsupported.
ErrorHandlerModelNote: Current default handler state only; custom handler flag/undefined-dispatch adaptation remains unsupported.
InitialCallModelNote: Readonly entry MFA from actual Erlang spawn descriptions; bare host callbacks have no native MFA and return undefined. Disconnected local surrogate children also have no description and remain explicitly unmodeled.
SuspendingModelNote: Existing targets/Owners per requesting process; long Count and Active split match native tuple; snapshots under shared gate.
